summary: Delete the deterministic five-step regex DoR gate (AISDLC-804); the DEC-0090 rule stays as rubric text

options.description: Remove checkFiveStepReview and its Gate-2 wiring; DEC-0090 remains a CLAUDE.md rule and DoR rubric item judged by the planner and the Stage-B reviewer
Keep the gate and fix the m-flag paragraph regex so it reads past the heading line

body: Operator decision in the planner session 2026-10-13 00:40Z. The gate checks for the presence of a word (delete/deleted/deletion/nothing to delete) in a paragraph it cannot even delimit correctly (five-step-review.ts:38, m flag makes $ match the heading line end). It caught no missing deletion and blocked four correctly written tasks (#1447) for a CI cycle. Five-step applied to the gate: requirement (DEC-0090, operator) kept as a rule; the regex automation (step 5 applied before steps 1-2 were settled) is deleted; the rubric text in the DoR prompt and CLAUDE.md remains the control. Velocity impact: positive, removes one false-negative CI round per filing PR.
